definitions.explanation: Illness caused by eating contaminated food, typically causing symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.

examples.english: I got food poisoning from eating raw oysters.

notes:
{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく} is food poisoning — illness caused by eating contaminated food.

Formation: {食|しょく} 'food' + ⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧ 'poisoning.' Note that ⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧ on its own also means 'addiction,' but in this compound only the poisoning sense is present.

Collocations:
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get food poisoning (of the sufferer)
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause an outbreak (of a food or an establishment)
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生：03133_hassei⟧: an outbreak occurs
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent food poisoning
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}{警報|けいほう}: a food-poisoning warning, issued by local authorities in hot, humid weather

Cultural note: {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく} is a live public-health topic in Japan, partly because raw and lightly cooked foods are common. Warnings peak in ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ for bacterial causes and in winter for norovirus. Common culprits named in the news: サルモネラ⟦{菌|きん}→菌：02682_kin⟧ (salmonella), ノロ⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧ (norovirus), O157 (a strain of E. coli), and カンピロバクター (campylobacter, associated with undercooked chicken).
